My conversations reinforced my belief that a society where basic needs are met and opportunities are accessible to all is not only more compassionate but also more conducive to overall well-being and genuine ambition. When people aren't solely focused on survival, they can truly contribute their best and innovative ideas, leading to a stronger society for everyone.
